_note: Story-state facts for The Oldest Tree. continuity_check.py votes on each. Add a rule every time a viewer is confused.

rules.question: Does this frame show a tree that has burned down, fallen over, snapped off, or been reduced to a stump or a log on the ground?
Is there a lit flashlight, lamp, lantern or any beam of artificial light anywhere in this frame?
Is the old man smiling, grinning or laughing?
Is the girl wearing a yellow raincoat?
Is a heart shape carved into the tree bark clearly visible in this frame?
Is the bark in this frame charred, burned black or ashy?
